description: Start a job to unwrap the UVs of one of the user's 3D models with Tripo Smart UV. Tripo Smart UV refuses a model with more than 80,000 triangles, so clean up a raw generated model first (chargen_edit_3d_cleanup can unwrap UVs in the same pass). Price: 30 Gold. First call chargen_quote_3d_uv, confirm the price with the user, then supply its quote_token with identical inputs. Spends the quoted Gold; returns request_id to poll with chargen_get_job, which gives the model file (media_url, model_format) when it is done. An identical call within about 10 minutes returns the earlier request instead of charging again; pass a new idempotency_key when the user wants another take with the same settings.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key (letters, numbers, - and _). Reusing it returns the same request without a new charge; a new key makes a new take with the same settings.

keep_textures.description: Keep the textures on the result (default true). Free.

model_id.description: A 3D model from the user's own gallery: an image_id from chargen_search_gallery with media_type model_3d, or a finished 3D job's image_id.

quote_token.description: Approved quote_token from chargen_quote_3d_uv. Use the same inputs; changed inputs or prices fail without charging.

name: chargen_edit_3d_uv
title: Unwrap 3D model UVs
